payoutTransfers.empty.title: No payout transfers
payoutTransfers.empty.body: Stripe transfers made for payouts show up here.
payoutTransfers.hint: Each Stripe payout is paid by one transfer. A failed or reversed amount goes back to the creator's earnings and is paid in a later run.
payoutTransfers.caption: Stripe transfers by payout run
payoutTransfers.col.creator: Creator
payoutTransfers.note.accountNotReady: The creator's Stripe account cannot receive payouts. The amount went back to their earnings.
payoutTransfers.note.held: The creator is under fraud review. The amount went back to their earnings.
payoutTransfers.note.outcomeUnknown: Stripe did not answer. Check the transfer in Stripe before paying it another way.
payoutTransfers.note.sentUnrecorded: Stripe sent it while the payout was on hold. It is recorded once the hold ends.
payoutTransfers.note.code: Stripe refused it (code {code}). The amount went back to the creator's earnings.
payoutTransfers.note.partlyReversed: Partly reversed. The reversed amount went back to the creator's earnings.
payoutTransfers.loadMoreFailed: Could not load more transfers. Try again in a moment.
payoutTransfers.loadFailed.title: Transfers did not load
payoutTransfers.loadFailed.body: Check your connection and try again.
